items.question: 15일 전 모바일 기기의 결제 완료 건수는?
items.sql:
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS mobile_payment_count
FROM
    events
WHERE
    timestamp >= (current_date - INTERVAL '15 days')
    AND timestamp <  (current_date - INTERVAL '14 days')
    AND event_name = 'is_payment'
    AND device_type = 'mobile';

items.question: 최근 7일 일별 문의 접수 건수 추이는?
items.sql:
SELECT
    summary_date AS date,
    event_count     AS contact_submissions
FROM agg_event_daily
WHERE
    event_name = 'contact_submit'
    AND summary_date >= current_date - 7
    AND summary_date <  current_date
ORDER BY summary_date;

items.question: 지난주 대비 이번 주 기기 유형별 세션 수를 비교해줘
items.reason: 정답 3번째 컬럼과 값이 같은 컬럼이 없음
items.sql:
SELECT
    device_type,
    SUM(CASE WHEN summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date THEN sessions END) AS sessions_this_week,
    SUM(CASE WHEN summary_date >= (date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7)
             AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date THEN sessions END) AS sessions_last_week
FROM agg_user_session_hourly
WHERE summary_date >= (date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7)
  AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
GROUP BY device_type
ORDER BY device_type;

items.question: 최근 7일과 그 전 7일의 nov_mega_sale 캠페인 세션 수를 비교해줘
items.sql:
SELECT
    SUM(CASE
            WHEN summary_date >= current_date - 7
                 AND summary_date < current_date
            THEN sessions
            ELSE 0
        END) AS recent_7d_sessions,
    SUM(CASE
            WHEN summary_date >= current_date - 14
                 AND summary_date < current_date - 7
            THEN sessions
            ELSE 0
        END) AS previous_7d_sessions
FROM agg_traffic_hourly
WHERE traffic_campaign = 'nov_mega_sale'
  AND summary_date >= current_date - 14
  AND summary_date < current_date;

items.question: 최근 28일 주말(토·일)과 평일의 하루 평균 세션 수를 비교해줘
items.sql:
WITH daily_sessions AS (
    SELECT
        summary_date,
        SUM(sessions) AS daily_sessions
    FROM agg_user_session_daily
    WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 28
      AND summary_date < current_date
    GROUP BY summary_date
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN EXTRACT(DOW FROM summary_date) IN (0, 6) THEN 'Weekend'
        ELSE 'Weekday'
    END AS day_type,
    AVG(daily_sessions)::numeric AS avg_sessions_per_day
FROM daily_sessions
GROUP BY day_type
ORDER BY day_type;

items.question: 최근 28일 요일별(ISO 요일 번호, 월=1) 이메일(email) 매체 유입 세션 수는?
items.sql:
SELECT 
    EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM summary_date)::int AS iso_weekday,
    SUM(sessions) AS email_sessions
FROM agg_traffic_hourly
WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 28
  AND summary_date < current_date
  AND traffic_medium = 'email'
GROUP BY iso_weekday
ORDER BY iso_weekday;

items.question: 15일 전과 14일 전의 기기 유형별 결제 완료 건수를 비교해줘
items.sql:
SELECT
    date_trunc('day', timestamp)::date AS event_date,
    device_type,
    COUNT(*) AS payment_count
FROM events
WHERE event_name = 'is_payment'
  AND timestamp >= current_date - 15
  AND timestamp <  current_date - 13
GROUP BY event_date, device_type
ORDER BY event_date, device_type;

items.question: 지난달과 이번 달의 일평균 페이지뷰를 비교해줘
items.sql:
WITH monthly AS (
    SELECT 
        date_trunc('month', summary_date)::date AS month_start,
        SUM(page_views)                         AS total_page_views,
        COUNT(DISTINCT summary_date)            AS days
    FROM agg_page_daily
    WHERE summary_date >= (date_trunc('month', current_date) - interval '1 month')::date
      AND summary_date <  (date_trunc('month', current_date) + interval '1 month')::date
    GROUP BY month_start
)
SELECT
    CASE 
        WHEN month_start = date_trunc('month', current_date)::date THEN '이번 달'
        ELSE '지난달'
    END                                 AS month,
    (total_page_views::numeric / NULLIF(days, 0)) AS avg_daily_page_views
FROM monthly
WHERE month_start IN (
    date_trunc('month', current_date)::date,
    (date_trunc('month', current_date) - interval '1 month')::date
)
ORDER BY month_start;

items.question: 최근 7일과 그 전 7일의 유입 소스(traffic_source)별 전환 수를 비교해줘
items.sql:
SELECT
    traffic_source,
    SUM(CASE
            WHEN summary_date >= current_date - 7
                 AND summary_date < current_date
            THEN conversions
            ELSE 0
        END) AS recent_conversions,
    SUM(CASE
            WHEN summary_date >= current_date - 14
                 AND summary_date < current_date - 7
            THEN conversions
            ELSE 0
        END) AS previous_conversions
FROM agg_traffic_hourly
WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 14
  AND summary_date < current_date
GROUP BY traffic_source
ORDER BY recent_conversions DESC
LIMIT 1000;

items.question: 최근 14일 일별 모바일과 데스크톱 세션 수를 날짜별 한 행에 나란히 보여줘
items.sql:
SELECT
    summary_date,
    SUM(CASE WHEN device_type = 'mobile'  THEN sessions ELSE 0 END) AS mobile_sessions,
    SUM(CASE WHEN device_type = 'desktop' THEN sessions ELSE 0 END) AS desktop_sessions
FROM agg_user_session_hourly
WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 14
  AND summary_date <  current_date
GROUP BY summary_date
ORDER BY summary_date;
